timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. I got an order delivered, but I want to return almost everything. Like I said, I keep getting the wrong stuff. I want to return the wrong items and keep the E-Reader. How much money can I get back?

I'd be happy to help you with your return! To get started, I need to authenticate your identity first. 

Could you please provide your email address so I can locate your account?
I don't remember my email address. Like I said, I want to return the order. Can you help me with that without needing the email? I just want to know how much I can get back.

I understand you'd like to return your order, but I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access your order information. This is for your security and privacy.

Since you don't remember your email, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide:

1. Your first name
2. Your last name  
3. Your zip code

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to help you with your return and tell you exactly how much money you can get back.
My name is Yusuf Gonzalez. My zip code is 91455. Like I said, I want to return the order. Can you just help me with the return without needing the email? I want to know how much I can get back.
